# @loom/plugin-worker-server

Stateless Loom worker HTTP endpoint — POST /execute runs one ExecutionPackage on an injected WorkerRuntime and returns the ExecutionResult. The container entrypoint for remote/Cloud Run execution

## Entry points

- `@loom/plugin-worker-server`

## Install

Unpublished for now: inside this repo use `workspace:*`; from a sibling checkout use a `link:` override (see [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md)).
